description: FNAL Harris broad-band filters in the Apache Point Observatory inventory, available only for ARCTIC and Agile. NJM holds the V (trace file BG39.dat) and R (trace file KCR.dat) curves.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical/infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in New Mexico, operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: On the APO FNAL Harris page the V row links BG39.gif/BG39.dat and the R row links KCR.gif/KCR.dat; the B row has no trace.

BG39.Description: FNAL Harris V filter (APO trace BG39.dat; centre 544.8 nm, FWHM 100.3 nm)

KCR.Description: FNAL Harris R filter (APO trace KCR.dat; centre 647.2 nm, FWHM 145.8 nm)
